title: ShowMandatory + OnQueryClosePage Check
summary: Two new UI community knowledge articles with code examples demonstrate best practices for marking required fields and validating request page input to prevent common defects like fields appearing optional or losing user input on validation errors.
key_points: ShowMandatory only draws the asterisk and TestField or NotBlank only enforce, so a required field needs both
The problem is worst on DelayedInsert list pages, where the error appears only after the user leaves the row
OnPreReport runs after the request page closes, so validate in OnQueryClosePage too to keep the user's input
Guard the OnQueryClosePage check on CloseAction so Cancel does not trap the user, and keep the OnPreReport check for runs with no request page
Both articles include bad and good AL samples
